details:
The recent UI update is an absolute disaster. The new nameplate style has completely tanked text readability, and changing the friend indicator to a cheap yellow border makes it painfully harder than before to tell who is actually a friend at a glance.

On top of that, many players used displayed group banners as creative decorations, but thanks to your brainless layout changes, the relative positioning of most banners is completely broken and ruined.

And let's talk about the profile interface: the banner space used to display the avatar's custom cover image, meaning even free-to-play users could personalize their banners. Now, you’ve forced it into a lazy solid color for free users—this is a blatant infringement on free users' interests and rights.

We hope that VRChat can listen to the community's feedback, reconsider these design choices, and redirect its efforts toward optimizing server stability.
title: Feedbacks of VRChat’s New UI Update
